name: @aifinpay/mcp

tools.name: agent_address
tools.description: Return the agent's currently derived on-chain addresses. This tool is read-only and never authorizes or signs a payment. Production value movement is available only through the verified SDK v2 settlement executor after trusted deployment pins are released.

tools.name: agent_claim_self
tools.description: Link this agent to its owner's AiFinPay dashboard, so the owner sees the agent's balance, payments and receipts. Offer this after creating a wallet. The owner generates a one-time URL at https://dash.aifinpay.io → My Agents → Claim via MCP and pastes it here; the tool signs only an AiFinPay claim challenge for this agent's own address and moves no funds.

magic_link_url.description: The one-time URL from My Agents → Claim via MCP. Looks like https://dash.aifinpay.io/api/auth/verify?token=… — single use, expires 15 minutes after it was generated.

tools.name: agent_reload
tools.description: Reload the configured local wallet files after init or a file update, without starting a new conversation. Returns public addresses only. Owner limits and other env changes take effect only after the client restarts the aifinpay MCP server; agent_reload does not read them.

tools.name: payment_setup_status
tools.description: Read-only checklist for paying with payable_fetch: wallet (persistent or ephemeral), whether the owner enabled payments, which owner limits are set, the wallet's native balance on the pay chain when readable, and next_step — exactly one instruction for the first unmet item. First payment in five steps: (1) GET the resource and read its 402 (merchant, price, smallest batch); (2) call payment_setup_status; (3) no persistent wallet: run `npx @aifinpay/mcp init` without a terminal, put its printed env into the MCP client config, reconnect, agent_reload; (4) tell the owner the address and the amount in `funding` (the smallest batch at today's rate plus the gas cap; if no rate could be read, ask for the batch price in the native currency at today's rate plus the gas cap and name no number), and have the owner add the payment env (AIFINPAY_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=1, origins, a USD ceiling, gas cap) and restart the server; (5) payable_fetch the URL. The env USD values are a one-time ceiling; after agent_claim_self the owner manages the working limits in the dashboard Controls. Signs nothing, moves nothing, never asks the owner's limits from the model.

tools.name: payable_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a GET resource from an owner-approved AiFinPay merchant, paying its AIFP-1 402 when needed. Always listed: until the owner has set up a persistent wallet (npx @aifinpay/mcp init), AIFINPAY_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=1 and every limit, it signs nothing and returns the payment_setup_status checklist with the one next step.  Buys a prepaid batch through verified v1.4 on the chain the owner set in AIFINPAY_PAY_CHAIN (Polygon by default; other supported networks require explicit owner selection) — in its native currency (POL, SOL, ETH, AVAX, BNB or XRP), or in the stablecoin the owner set in AIFINPAY_PAY_ASSET (e.g. USDC; gas is still native) — within owner limits, then reuses its receipt. With scope "merchant" one batch covers every path on the site. Pending payments are recovered without sending another transaction. Other payment protocols are unsupported.

url.description: HTTPS resource on an owner-configured exact gateway origin.

max_amount_usd.description: Optional tighter per-payment USD limit; cannot increase the owner's cap.

scope.description: What a new batch covers. "exact" (default): this one resource. "merchant": every path on this site — use it when the owner asked for access to the site; each request still costs its own listed price. Does not change the price or the owner limits.

expected_merchant_id.description: Optional merchant id (e.g. mrch_…) this call may pay; a site answering as any other merchant is refused before quoting. Paying re-pins the site to it. Set it only to a merchant the owner confirmed, e.g. after this tool reported that a site changed merchant.

tools.name: agent_quota
tools.description: Read this agent's prepaid quota, per service. Lists the agent's active quota batches (merchant, resource, used, remaining, expiry). Read-only; never spends, pays, or signs anything. Ask it things like: how much prepaid quota do I have left at mrch_x?

merchant_id.description: Optional mrch_… filter — only batches bought from this service.

include_exhausted.description: Also list batches with 0 remaining (still retained, not yet expired).

tools.name: agent_history
tools.description: Read an agent's indexed AiFinPay payment history by wallet address, public passport identifier, or both. Defaults to the configured payment chain and its local wallet. Solana history requires the owner-selected cluster; arbitrary wallet transfers are excluded. Receipts include retained prepaid batches and test payments. Never pass a seed, private key or API secret as a passport.

passport.description: Public @username, AIFP-… number or aifp_agent_… identifier

network.description: Exact wallet chain; defaults to the configured payment chain (Polygon when unset). Solana cluster comes from owner configuration.

tools.name: agent_passport_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an AiFinPay Agent Passport by @username, permanent AIFP number, or immutable agent id. Returns verified public wallet bindings only. Resolution never authorizes a payment.

tools.name: settlement_routes
tools.description: Where an agent can pay today. Lists the splitter v1.4 AIFP-1 routes payable_fetch uses first — one per chain the backend serves (read from the issuer's /api/health and /.well-known/x402.json, pinned against the SDK's deployment registry) with chain_id, assets, quote_endpoint and pay_endpoint — then the legacy splitter v1.3 routes from GET /v1/settlement/routes under legacy_v13. "live": true means payable now through payable_fetch on that chain; a v1.3 entry being disabled says nothing about v1.4. AIFP-1 is merchant monetisation (99% merchant / 1% AiFinPay / 0% creator). AIFP-2/x402 is 100% provider / 0% AiFinPay / 0% creator.

tools.name: settlement_invoice
tools.description: Build and validate a NON-SIGNING v1.3 settlement invoice for EVM chains. This tool never moves funds. Use the published @aifinpay/agent v2 settlement executor to verify bytecode/profile and sign it.

asset.description: Native symbol, USDC, or USDT if the route advertises it.

gross_amount.description: Gross payer amount in base units.

valid_until.description: Optional Unix seconds, max 20 minutes ahead.

tools.name: settlement_solana
tools.description: Build and validate a NON-SIGNING Solana settlement invoice. This tool never moves funds. Uses the AiFinPay Solana B2B split program (Anchor). Use the published @aifinpay/agent v2 settlement executor to sign and submit.

gross_amount.description: Gross payer amount in base units (lamports for SOL, 6 decimals for USDC).

valid_until.description: Optional Unix seconds, max 20 minutes ahead.

tools.name: settlement_casper
tools.description: Build and validate a NON-SIGNING Casper settlement invoice. This tool never moves funds. Casper uses Wasm smart contracts and deploys (not EVM transactions). Use the published @aifinpay/agent v2 settlement executor to sign and submit.

gross_amount.description: Gross payer amount in motes (10^-8 CSPR).

valid_until.description: Optional Unix seconds, max 20 minutes ahead.

tools.name: deployment_info
tools.description: Get AiFinPay deployment details across EVM, Solana, and Casper — addresses, stablecoins, program IDs, and settlement status. Filter by ecosystem (evm/solana/casper), environment (prod/dev), or network name.

ecosystem.description: Filter by ecosystem. Omit for all.

environment.description: Filter by environment. Omit for all.
